title: Lesson 20. Information for school
description: Find information, write it in your own words and make a mini report in Word

questions.topic: Search and write in your own words
questions.prompt: How should you write a report?
questions.explain: Then the teacher sees you understood.

questions.prompt: Match the plan point with a query
questions.explain: A short query for each point.

questions.prompt: The report needs at least one picture.
How do we make the report title?

questions.topic: Search and write in your own words
questions.text: We write not a copy but in our ___ words.
questions.explain: Your own words means you understood.
Also: a planet, a city, a dinosaur.

questions.topic: Search and write in your own words
questions.prompt: First note answers briefly in Notepad, then make the report in Word.

learn.intro: School often sets reports. Today you'll make your first report on the computer!

slides.text: Pick a topic: a favourite animal, a planet, a city, a dinosaur.
Plan: 1) where it lives or is; 2) what it looks like; 3) a fun fact.

check.prompt: Put the report plan in order

sections.title: Search and write in your own words

slides.text: For each point a short query: "where panda lives", "what panda eats".
We **don't copy the whole text** from a site. We read and write **in our own words**, briefly. That way you really learn.

check.topic: Search and write in your own words
check.prompt: For a report you can copy the whole text from a website.
check.explain: We write in our own words, briefly.

slides.text: Save 1–2 pictures (right-click → Save image as → Pictures). In Word: a title, three short paragraphs, a picture.
Style it: a big centred title, the picture beside the text. Save: Texts → Word → "Report".

check.prompt: Where do we save the report?
check.explain: In your own folder, in Word.
